DAR.thesis: Rising diesel prices and widening crack spreads create favorable margins for renewable diesel producers with structural cost advantage from feedstock that rises slower than crude.

SWBI.thesis: Improving production and rising plant utilization drive meaningful margin expansion with market share gains amid competitor distraction and industry consolidation.

MUSA.thesis: Levered to fuel price volatility and rate-of-change dynamics that drive both margin expansion and traffic through price-led model with higher mix of gasoline, energy drinks, and nicotine sales.

ULS.thesis: High-quality capital-light TIC franchise benefiting from structural shift to for-profit model with durable secular tailwinds including AI/data center buildout and rising global regulation.

CAVA.thesis: Sustained traffic growth, best-in-class unit economics, and differentiated Mediterranean positioning support path back to high-single-digit/double-digit comps and multiple expansion.

APD.thesis: New leadership shifts away from uneconomic green capital deployment toward shareholder discipline, positioning recovery from underperformance in highest-quality industrial gases business.

AMZN.thesis: Accelerating AWS growth, expanding AI infrastructure capacity, and improving retail operating leverage reinforce Amazon's leadership across cloud and commerce with robotics and logistics optionality.

ROKU.thesis: Accelerating platform monetization with high-margin advertising and subscription revenue transforming business into scaled connected-TV software platform with powerful operating leverage cycle.

CARR.thesis: Accelerating demand for climate and energy-efficiency solutions with secular growth across HVAC replacement cycles, data center cooling, and electrification supporting durable organic expansion.

SXT.thesis: Accelerating industry-wide shift from synthetic petroleum-based food dyes toward natural colors driven by regulation and consumer pressure, with Sensient uniquely positioned as leading U.S. supplier.

ROP.thesis: Serial acquisition story dependent on perpetual flawless capital allocation with eroding software moats and increasing substitutability risk as pool of suitable assets shrinks.

RBLX.thesis: Slowing user growth with decelerating daily active users and bookings confirmed by management guidance cuts, setting up high-risk Q3 trough with multiple near-term headwinds.

ONON.thesis: CEO departure signals inflection toward slower growth while structurally unsustainable margins above 60% face normalization pressure as scale increases and competitive pressures from Nike intensify.

OLLI.thesis: Underperforming despite peak operating environment with slowing comps and declining store productivity signaling structural weakness as unit growth masks weakening operating model.

HCA.thesis: Weak MA rate relief fails to offset structural pressure on hospital reimbursements with deteriorating metrics across admissions, wage inflation, and surgical volumes signaling slowing demand.

WING.thesis: Transaction data deteriorates sharply with credit card activity down ~25% YoY and core initiatives failing to drive incremental traffic, with structural weakening demand outlook requiring growth reset.

DGX.thesis: Investors overestimate durability of GLP-1 adoption testing tailwinds which may prove cyclical rather than structural, with low-growth core diagnostics exposed to deteriorating healthcare consumption.

from_desk.macro_view: The US is in a Quad 2 regime (Growth and Inflation accelerating) at the monthly level with Quad 3 (Stagflation Protection) at quarterly and global levels. Rising rates, falling duration, and broadening reflation across commodities characterize the current market environment.
